description: Main-process Crossplane service: isolated per-context KubeConfig adapter with request counting, detection, MR kind index, snapshot fetchers, warning events, MR scan/items, relationship tree walk, per-context LRU cache with TTLs and in-flight dedupe, ten read-only crossplane:* IPC channels via safeHandle + zod, preload bridge and typings. Implements plan.md items 7-12; design B.5, B.7 (walk), B.8, B.9, B.12, B.13 and amendment AM-3. Depends on FEAT-001 (types, utils, summaries, schemas).
steps: Read design.md B.5, B.7, B.8, B.9 (file plan rows for electron/*), B.12, B.13, B.14 (electron tests) and AM-3; read plan.md items 7-12; read FEAT-001 findings.

electron/k8s.ts (git status + re-read first; additive str_replace only): add `export` before the existing `function sanitizeK8sErrorMessage` (~line 58); add public method createContextKubeConfig(contextName: string): KubeConfig on K8sService (new KubeConfig(), loadFromDefault(), throw new Error(`Unknown kube context: ${contextName}`) if not in getContexts(), setCurrentContext, return).

Create electron/crossplane-api.ts per the B.9 file-plan row: CrossplaneApi interface, createCrossplaneApi(kcFactory, context, opts) building clients via createConfiguration({ baseServer: new ServerConfiguration(server, {}), authMethods: { default: kc }, promiseMiddleware: [countingMiddleware] }); getApiGroups, getGroupResources (core -> /api/v1), listPage, listAllPages (B.5 shared list helper semantics), get(ref, plural), listCrdMetadata (PartialObjectMetadataList Accept header), listWarningEventsPage, findCoreDeployment (A3); withTimeout 30s; one 401 rebuild+retry; CrossplaneApiError {status,message} using sanitizeK8sErrorMessage; LUMEN_DEBUG_CROSSPLANE=1 logging; export createLimiter(n).

Create electron/crossplane-discovery.ts (crossview attribution header from B.1): detect (B.5 Detection 1-6), resolveGroupKinds, buildManagedKinds (objectRefs path via partitionObjectRefs/resolveKindVersion, crdMetadata fallback, fingerprint via revisionFingerprint).

Create electron/crossplane-snapshots.ts: fetchPackages (two-phase; ProviderConfig phase via partitionObjectRefs + resolveGroupKinds; peekManagedKinds fallback; providerApiGroups; fingerprint callback), fetchDefinitions (incl. Function used-by), fetchComposites (XR/claim per XRD referenceable version, usages, operations), fetchWarningEvents (B.5 Warning events 1-6). Per-fetch 6-slot limiter; per-section error mapping; all-status-0 -> 'Cluster unreachable'. If the file exceeds ~480 lines, move fetchWarningEvents into electron/crossplane-events.ts.

Create electron/crossplane-tree.ts: B.7 walk steps 0-6 (await definitions, ascend <=4, BFS descend, concurrency 8, Secret -> notFetched, 404 missing, 403 forbidden, error, depth 6, 300 nodes truncated, uid cycle guard, warnings).

Create electron/crossplane.ts CrossplaneService({ kubeConfigFactory, emitProgress, apiFactory?, now? }): per-context LRU(3); TTLs per B.5 cache table; in-flight dedupe where `force` skips the cached value but JOINS any in-flight promise for the same key and never starts a second concurrent fetch (AM-3); peekManagedKinds; latestRevisionFingerprint + eviction; scanManaged ALWAYS calls getManagedKinds(ctx, { force: false }) and its own `force` bypasses only the scan-summary cache (AM-3); single scan with AbortController cancel on context change; per-kind promise map; shared 6-slot MR limiter; 50k cached-row cap; 250ms-throttled emitProgress; getManagedItems steps 1-4; getResource (reject core v1 Secret with 'Secrets are not fetched by the Crossplane view'; strip metadata.managedFields and kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration); getTree; invalidateKubeConfigs.

Create electron/crossplane-ipc.ts registerCrossplaneIpc(service): ten safeHandle registrations with the FEAT-001 schemas; validateK8sParam on ref apiVersion/kind/name/namespace as defence in depth; Secret rejection.

Wire (git status + re-read each file first; additive only): electron/main.ts — import, instantiate crossplaneService with kubeConfigFactory: (ctx) => k8sService.createContextKubeConfig(ctx) and guarded win.webContents.send('crossplane:scanProgress', p); call registerCrossplaneIpc(crossplaneService) inside registerIpcHandlers() (~line 484); add crossplaneService.invalidateKubeConfigs() inside the k8s:forceCredentialRefresh handler (~line 600). electron/preload.ts — `crossplane` namespace next to `helm` (~line 427) with positional methods packing one object, onScanProgress returning removeListener for only its own listener. electron/electron-env.d.ts (inline import('../src/types/crossplane').X style) and src/vite-env.d.ts (import type) — window.k8s.crossplane typings.

Create shared fake electron/__fixtures__/fake-crossplane-api.ts (records calls, peak concurrency, request count) and tests electron/crossplane.test.ts, electron/crossplane-discovery.test.ts, electron/crossplane-snapshots.test.ts, electron/crossplane-tree.test.ts, electron/crossplane-ipc-schemas.test.ts covering every B.14 electron bullet plus AM-3 (forced call during in-flight joins it: exactly one API call; scanManaged during a forced getManagedKinds build joins it; scanManaged(force) re-scans but does not rebuild a cached kind index) and schema rejection of malformed input, extra keys, and Secret refs at the handler level (test the handler logic via the service, not Electron).
acceptance_criteria: `npx tsc --noEmit` exits 0 and `npx vite build` succeeds.
`npx vitest run` passes all tests including the new electron/crossplane*.test.ts files.
The P + V + sum(pages(n_k)) request-count test (mixed-version group, empty kind=1, 1200 kind=3, 6000 kind=10, unserved group=0) passes.
AM-3 tests pass: force joins in-flight, scanManaged uses getManagedKinds({force:false}).
`npx eslint --max-warnings 0 electron/crossplane*.ts electron/__fixtures__` reports 0 problems; `npm run lint` total problems <= 1608 (baseline).
git diff of electron/k8s.ts, electron/main.ts, electron/preload.ts, electron/electron-env.d.ts, src/vite-env.d.ts shows the user's pre-existing hunks unchanged plus only additive insertions.
All crossplane:* channels are READ-only (no create/patch/delete calls anywhere in electron/crossplane*.ts). Every new file < 500 lines.
verification: npx eslint --max-warnings 0 electron/crossplane-api.ts electron/crossplane-discovery.ts electron/crossplane-snapshots.ts electron/crossplane-tree.ts electron/crossplane.ts electron/crossplane-ipc.ts electron/crossplane-ipc-schemas.ts electron/__fixtures__
npm run lint 2>&1 | tail -3   (total must be <= 1608 problems)
findings:
FILES (new, uncommitted): electron/crossplane-api.ts (351), electron/crossplane-discovery.ts (347, crossview attribution), electron/crossplane-snapshots.ts (254), electron/crossplane-events.ts (53, fetchWarningEvents split out), electron/crossplane-tree.ts (204), electron/crossplane.ts (413), electron/crossplane-ipc.ts (25); tests electron/crossplane{,-discovery,-snapshots,-tree,-ipc-schemas}.test.ts (219/181/159/123/47); fixtures electron/__fixtures__/fake-crossplane-api.ts (228), electron/__fixtures__/crossplane-service-harness.ts (41). All < 500 lines, no `any`. MODIFIED (additive only): electron/k8s.ts (`export` on sanitizeK8sErrorMessage + public createContextKubeConfig(ctx) — it uses the private loadKubeConfig() so the custom settings_kubeconfigPath is honoured like K8sService; throws 'Unknown kube context: X'), electron/main.ts (2 imports, crossplaneService instantiation after k8sService with guarded win.webContents.send('crossplane:scanProgress'), registerCrossplaneIpc(crossplaneService) at top of registerIpcHandlers(), crossplaneService.invalidateKubeConfigs() in k8s:forceCredentialRefresh), electron/preload.ts (type import + crossplaneArgs helper that omits undefined option keys + `crossplane` block after helm), electron/electron-env.d.ts and src/vite-env.d.ts (window.k8s.crossplane typings). The user edited k8s.ts/main.ts/env typings in parallel during this step; those hunks were left untouched.

PRELOAD API window.k8s.crossplane (each packs ONE object): detect|getPackages|getDefinitions|getComposites|getManagedKinds|scanManaged(context, opts?: {force?}) ; getManagedItems(context, kindKeys: string[], opts?: {force?}) ; getWarningEvents(context, opts?: {limit?, force?}) ; getResource(context, ref: CrossplaneObjectRef) -> Record<string, unknown> ; getTree(context, ref) -> CrossplaneTree ; onScanProgress(cb) -> unsubscribe (removeListener of its own listener only). Callers must pass toCrossplaneRef(x).

SERVICE API (electron/crossplane.ts): new CrossplaneService({ kubeConfigFactory, emitProgress, apiFactory?, now? }); detect, getPackages, getDefinitions, getComposites, getManagedKinds, peekManagedKinds, scanManaged, getManagedItems, getWarningEvents({limit=50}), getResource, getTree, invalidateKubeConfigs, requestCount(ctx). Exports TTL, MAX_CONTEXTS=3, MAX_CACHED_ROWS=50000, MAX_UNHEALTHY=200, SECRET_REFUSAL, assertSafeRef (validateK8sParam on ref fields + Secret refusal; used by getResource/getTree so the IPC handler logic is testable without Electron), stripObject. Cache: per-context LRU(3); generic cached(): non-forced returns a fresh hit, otherwise joins any in-flight promise for the key (force included, AM-3), rejected promises not cached. Kind index cached with its fingerprint; getPackages records latestRevisionFingerprint and evicts a mismatching entry; a stale in-flight build is returned but not cached. scanManaged always uses getManagedKinds({force:false}); force bypasses only the scan-summary cache; one global scan, another context aborts it (status 'cancelled', nothing cached); per-kind promise map + shared 6-slot MR limiter; getManagedItems joins pending scan kinds, else lists directly (also after cancellation). Adapter (electron/crossplane-api.ts): CrossplaneApi interface {context, requestCount, getApiGroups, getGroupResources, listPage, get(ref, plural?), listCrdMetadataPage, listWarningEventsPage, findCoreDeployment, invalidate}; createCrossplaneApi(kcFactory, context, opts) builds every client with createConfiguration({baseServer: new ServerConfiguration(server,{}), authMethods:{default: kc}, promiseMiddleware:[counting]}), 30 s withTimeout, one 401 rebuild+retry, kubeconfig reuse 10 min, LUMEN_DEBUG_CROSSPLANE=1 log; CRD metadata uses setHeaderOptions('Accept', PartialObjectMetadataList); typed results converted to plain JSON (Dates -> ISO). Also exports CrossplaneApiError, CrossplaneAbortError, toCrossplaneApiError, createLimiter, listAllPages(api, gvr, opts) (standalone helper rather than an interface method, so fakes only implement listPage), imageTag, pickCoreDeployment. Discovery: CrossplaneDiscovery (per-context /apis + group/version resource cache, 5 min, in-flight dedupe, resolveKind), CORE_KINDS, coreGvr, detectCrossplane, resolveGroupKinds, buildManagedKinds, allManagedKinds, trimRevision. ManagedKindsPayload.source is 'objectRefs' (the type from FEAT-001) where the design text says 'providerRevisions'.

DEVIATION NOTE: getPackages also awaits getDefinitions (15 s cache, never MR discovery) to fill Function usedByCompositions/usedByCount, since CrossplaneDefinitionsPayload has no field for it; a definitions failure leaves them empty.
